resolution: Selection explains a trait by its past reproductive effects; coupling explains emergence by interactions. Aquinas’ intentio is broad immanent tending, which neither mechanism’s definition denies. Intelligent direction is a further ordering relation, not identical with a component interaction. The global naturalistic thesis denies that further director, an open philosophical claim not attributed to Darwin, Blount or Dye. Neither the no-chance observation nor the presence of a mechanism entails this denial. GovernedMechanismsModel establishes coexistence; the biological/nonliving and local/universal tests block scope changes. No result identifies random variation with Aquinas’ rare coincidence.
